title: Lollipop Jones, the Dewdrop comedian
summary: Description of Lollipop Jones, the Dewdrop MC: his size, costumes, dancing and jokes, and the drag shows.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: And who was Lollipop Jones?
Oh, he was a great comedian.
I never saw him.
Oh, he was good, Lollipop was good. He was great. He was the MC for the Dewdrops.
What did he look like?
Oh, well, he was stout. See, but no stouter than me, and about five feet level, no taller than when I was. Black.
Mustache, as I've seen. I've seen his picture.
Well, no, I don't think he wore much of a mustache. I was a dark brown skin fella, but not nothing too much to look at.
Over 200 pounds.
He was nicer looking at me, you know, that's what I'm trying to tell you. Yeah.
He weighed over 200 pounds?
Yeah, man.
And what, how did...
He started pulling our weight, I guess, on the car. He got kind of sick and he started pulling weight down.
What kind of costumes would he wear?
Oh, he wore some outgoing costumes.
Outguns?

Yeah, he really did, though. He dressed as comical, man. He dressed, you know, he had his tails on, you know, how they was made. He had, boy, he wore, you know, like two shoes together, you know. And his shoes stick out way out there, man. He was in cakes.
Would the shoes match?

He had his two, yeah, he had, well, he put on two shoes to one foot, you know. Yeah? Yeah, that's the way it was. They were all cut up and wide and everything. Then he could dance a little bit, he danced with them, you know. Oh, man, he was great. He really was great. Tell plenty of good jokes.
Do you remember any of his jokes?
No.
That must have been funny, because everybody talks about it, but I never saw him. I always missed him. He wore women's dresses and everything.
Yeah, he was something else, man.
Was he a drag queen? I don't think... Just a comedian? Or do you know?
Huh?
Was he a drag queen or a comedian or what?
I think he was a comedian.
Just a comedian. Yeah, but they used to have some real good drag queens at the dude's house.
Oh, yeah, they had many of those, yeah. They did.
They made famous ones there.
It was savage for that.
